home.introText: At Suzhou Huihai Sanitary Products Co., Ltd., we combine nonwoven fiber engineering with strict cleanroom processing. Located in Suzhou, China, our plant manufactures premium electrostatic dusters and microfiber consumables designed to meet the rigorous quality standards of partners in Japan, Europe, and North America.

about.title: About Suzhou Huihai Sanitary Products Co., Ltd.
about.subtitle: A dedicated manufacturing entity focused on nonwoven hygiene technology and electrostatic fiber precision.
about.storyText: Suzhou Huihai Sanitary Products Co., Ltd. (苏州汇海卫生用品有限公司) is situated in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China. We operate a modern dust-free cleanroom manufacturing facility dedicated to disposable electrostatic dusting heads, mop refill wipes, and premium microfiber towels. We serve international buyers seeking consistent quality, transparent manufacturing, and reliable long-term supply.
about.addressValFull: Address: No. 8 Yueyang Road, Yuewang Town, Taicang City, Jiangsu Province, China
about.facilityVal: Automated Production Lines & Nonwoven R&D Facility
about.patentsVal: Intellectual Property: 30+ Patents (Utility Models & PCT Applications)
about.pillar1Text: Controlled dust-free manufacturing environment ensuring pristine fiber cleanliness and zero contamination.
about.pillar2Text: Proprietary nonwoven fiber structures engineered for high static charge retention and dust trap performance.
about.pillar3Text: High-precision automated cutting and packaging lines ensuring consistent unit weights and sealing integrity.
about.pillar4Text: Batch testing for tensile strength, fiber lint dispersion, weight consistency, and electrostatic attraction.

oem.matrixDesc: Suzhou Huihai Sanitary Products Co., Ltd. provides flexible custom manufacturing solutions tailored for retail brands, supermarket chains, and B2B distributors in Japan, Europe, and North America. From fiber GSM adjustments to private label retail packaging, we accommodate your exact market specifications.

oem.step2Text: Custom prototype samples dispatched for client verification and approval.
oem.step3Text: Precision automated manufacturing under strict batch control and quality checks.
